Stream Distances to Matrix

fwa_stream_distances_to_matrix.Rd

Calculates the distances along the stream network between stream distances (river meters). The distance is Inf if the river meters are on streams that are not connected.

Usage

fwa_stream_distances_to_matrix(x, streams, id = NULL)

Arguments

x

A data frame (including sf objects) with whole numeric column blk and numeric column rm of the river meters. All blk values must be in streams$blk and all rm values must be non-negative.

streams

A data frame with whole numeric column blk, whole numeric column parent_blk and numeric column parent_rm. The stream network must not be circular.

id

A string of the name of a column in x with unique non-missing values that are converted to character and used as the row and column names of the matrix or NULL.

Value

A numeric matrix of the distances in m with one row and one column for each row in x.

Details

The stream network is defined by the parent blue line key (parent_blk) and the river meter on the parent where each stream joins it (parent_rm) as returned by fwa_add_parent_to_streams(). Parents that are not in streams$blk are treated as root streams.

See also

fwa_add_parent_to_streams()

Examples

streams <- data.frame(
  blk = c(1, 2, 3),
  parent_blk = c(NA, 1, NA),
  parent_rm = c(NA, 400, NA)
)
rms <- data.frame(
  site = c("a", "b", "c", "d"),
  blk = c(1, 1, 2, 3),
  rm = c(100, 500, 50, 10)
)
fwa_stream_distances_to_matrix(rms, streams)
#>      [,1] [,2] [,3] [,4]
#> [1,]    0  400  350  Inf
#> [2,]  400    0  150  Inf
#> [3,]  350  150    0  Inf
#> [4,]  Inf  Inf  Inf    0
fwa_stream_distances_to_matrix(rms, streams, id = "site")
#>     a   b   c   d
#> a   0 400 350 Inf
#> b 400   0 150 Inf
#> c 350 150   0 Inf
#> d Inf Inf Inf   0
